operational_references.reason: Large-enterprise ERP, CRM, data and workflow-suite reference, but the current SEC pipeline does not support SAP's foreign-issuer filing regime.
Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Copilot are direct strategic references, but Azure and Office make Microsoft's consolidated multiple unsuitable for CRM medians.

review.rationale: Salesforce requires separate enterprise-suite, direct customer-platform and AI/software-quality lenses. NOW is the closest quality and growth peer; HUBS is the closest product-level CRM peer at materially smaller scale.
